analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($134.90) vs SMA5($115.94)/SMA20($114.72)/SMA50($127.81): Short-term/mid-term trend above, attempting to hold above SMA50 after breakout.
· Position vs SMA100($165.04)/SMA200($112.80): Below mid-long term trend, attempting to recover mid-long term trend by staying above SMA200.
· 52-week Position (37.7%) + Current price level is high relative to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (39.5 → 56.7): Attempting to establish in neutral zone after exiting oversold, confirming upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (1.1151 → 3.0232): Continued improvement, bullish expansion signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Upper Band $132.10): Approaching upper band, with band width expanding to 30.29%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($116.47): Based on SMA200 and Pivot S1.
· Swing Resistance ($156.92): Based on 52-week high and R2, potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Confirmed recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.32x vs 5-day average): Low volume, potential for weakening upward momentum.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend): Entering long based on RSI/MACD improvement and Higher Low pattern, but low volume and weak weekly chart are risk factors.
